items.name: North Star Cubing Challenge 2024
items.information:
This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0pKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--32acfbd57bc17bb5a9220c05cd176c7d4267c868/image.png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation ](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing)for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

items.name: Connecticut Winter 2024
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. 

# **Note: Please refer to the Guest Information tab for information on venue restrictions.**
